scripts.build: paraglide-js compile --project ./project.inlang --outdir ./src/paraglide --strategy cookie preferredLanguage baseLocale --output-structure locale-modules --silent && node -e "if (!require('fs').readFileSync('src/paraglide/messages/_index.js', 'utf8').includes('app_name')) { console.error('i18n: the compiled catalog is empty; a plugin failed to load'); process.exit(1) }"
